Cyclops (CV 34)

A single cloudy eye dominates the face of a giant who carves fragments of dreams into roadside stones.

Attributes: Brawn +2; Fortitude +2; Agility +0; Guile -1; Knowledge -1; Reason +0

HP: 38 · Speed: 6 · Size: 2 (2x2 squares) · Armor DR: 1

Evasion: None · Threat: 1 Bane · Stability: 2

Weaknesses: None\ Resistances: Physical (1)\ Immunities: None

Actions

Damage and effects are Weak / Standard / Strong player defense. Each slash separates a complete outcome. All attacks use printed Threat unless stated otherwise.

Details

Stone-brow axe

Target: One visible creature within 2 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Weak defense: Prone.

Thrown stone

Target: One visible creature within 7 squares. Player defense: Agility. Damage type: physical.

Limit: Requires an available loose stone; picking it up is part of this attack. No stone means this attack is unavailable.

Study the Opening

It waits for a tell in the stance, then turns its attention to the exposed line.

Its next attack before the end of this turn imposes 1 additional Bane on player defense, or gains 1 Boon when player-controlled. One attack only; no stacking with itself.

Seen It Already

It starts moving a heartbeat before the strike, following a future the attacker has not yet reached.

Before one attack from a visible attacker against this creature is rolled, impose 1 Bane on that attack. Against an NPC attack, grant 1 Boon to its single defense roll instead. This changes no target or outcome after dice have been rolled; it does not cancel the action.

General details

Basic Melee: One adjacent creature; physical damage; Agility defense. Uses printed Threat. No specialty riders.

Defend: Player attacks suffer 1 additional Bane until its next turn. Combines with Evasion through normal Boon/Bane rules; repeated Defend does not stack.

Opportunity Attack: Basic Melee against the provoking creature; spend its Reaction before the provoking action resolves. That action continues if capable.

Heavy Frame — Passive: Stability 2; an explicit trait, not a bonus calculated from Size.

Healing: Living: ordinary HP healing applies.

Senses: Ordinary sight and hearing.

Tactics and retreat: Study the opening before committing to the axe, or throw a stone when a narrow approach would surrender its reach advantage.

Encounter and conversation: The cyclops recognizes the party from a vision but has misunderstood which part of it was a warning.

Habitat: Highland; quarry; remote stronghold · Communication: Common and Giant

Loot: Recoverable possessions or lair clues chosen for the adventure; body parts grant no automatic special equipment or coin value.

Summoning: Ineligible.

Design notes — not needed during play
